svg.title: N0zoM1z0 · Contribution Arcade · 18 / MATCH THREE
svg.desc: 13,956 GitHub contributions across 138 active days, 2025-10-12 to 2026-10-14. Every gem represents a real active date and is colored by its GitHub intensity. Adjacent swaps create runs of at least three. Matched dates bank their actual contribution counts, surviving gems fall, and remaining dates refill the board for further cascades.

g.text: Every gem is an actual active date.
Every gem is an actual active date.
